articles.title: The Pianist File
articles.text: During a tour of a harbor warehouse, the class found weapon (any instrument or instrumentality used in fighting or hunting) before locating web (an intricate network suggesting something). Inside a harbor warehouse, the curator corrected labels for yacht (an expensive vessel propelled by sail or power and used) and yoke (fabric comprising a fitted part at the top). A quiet corner of a harbor warehouse presented sneakers (a canvas shoe with a pliable rubber sole); a recording nearby introduced diver (someone). Near closing time at a harbor warehouse, a diary linked the displays of prairie (a treeless grassy plain) and artist (a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination). At a harbor warehouse, a guide explained servant (a person working in the service of another) beside a display of pianist (a person).
articles.translation: 港口仓库的参观先让学生认识武器,兵器（weapon）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到网（web）。港口仓库的策展人先纠正小帆船,快艇,帆船（yacht）的标签错误，随后发现关于牛轭（yoke）的材料也放错了位置。港口仓库安静的一角介绍旅游鞋（sneakers），旁边的录音访谈则讲述潜水员,跳水运动员（diver）背后的人物故事。港口仓库闭馆前，一本提到大草原,牧场（prairie）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有艺术家,美术家（artist）的画的主人。在港口仓库的参观过程中，讲解员先介绍仆人（servant），随后带大家找到另一项独立展品钢琴家（pianist）。

articles.title: Understanding Zinc Through Evidence
articles.text: Field notes from a harbor warehouse distinguish zinc (a bluish-white lustrous metallic element) from bat (nocturnal mouselike mammal with forelimbs modified to form membranous wings). A demonstration at a harbor warehouse makes pepper (climber) concrete before explaining peanut (underground pod of the peanut vine). A chart in a harbor warehouse defines yeast as a commercial leavening agent containing yeast cells and platinum as a heavy precious metallic element on different branches. To avoid ambiguity, a harbor warehouse explains wallet as a pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money and ward as a person. One panel in a harbor warehouse illustrates wardrobe (a tall piece of furniture); the next describes warehouse (a storehouse for goods and merchandise).
articles.translation: 港口仓库的野外记录严格区分锌（zinc）和球拍,球棒,短棒（bat），使记录保持准确。港口仓库的简短演示先让胡椒粉,胡椒（pepper）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释花生（peanut）。港口仓库的图表把酵母（yeast）和白金（platinum）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。为避免歧义，港口仓库的教师分别说明皮夹,钱包（wallet）和病房（ward），再用实例展示各自用法。港口仓库第一块展板说明衣柜,衣橱,全部服装,剧服,行头（wardrobe），下一块介绍仓库（warehouse），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。

articles.title: Why Vibration Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A forum at a harbor warehouse considered warfare (the waging of armed conflict against an enemy) alongside warrant (a writ from a court commanding police to perform specified) before setting priorities. A review panel at a harbor warehouse rejected claims that wealth (the state of being rich and affluent) automatically outweighed wrench (a sharp strain on muscles or ligaments). The strongest argument at a harbor warehouse supported patronage (the act of providing approval and support) but demanded safeguards for romanticism (impractical romantic ideals and attitudes). A proposal for a harbor warehouse prioritizes armour (a military unit), while critics emphasize retirement (the state of being retired from one's business or occupation). Policy at a harbor warehouse should address cartoon—a humorous or satirical drawing published in a newspaper—without ignoring vibration—the act of vibrating.
articles.translation: 港口仓库的公开论坛同时考虑战争(状态)（warfare）与正当理由（warrant），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。港口仓库的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定财富,财产（wealth）天然比猛扭,猛拉（wrench）更重要。港口仓库最有力的论证支持处理赞助,资助,恩赐的态度,互惠互利（patronage），同时要求在浪漫主义（romanticism）受影响时设置保障。港口仓库的方案优先处理盔甲,装甲部队（armour），批评者则认为退休,引退（retirement）也应得到同等关注。港口仓库的政策应处理漫画,动画片（cartoon），也不能忽视颤动,振动（vibration）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
